# Halco Basement Systems

> > Halco Basement Systems provides basement waterproofing, crawl space repair, and Total Basement Finishing services throughout the Finger Lakes region of New York.

Serving Geneva, Syracuse, Farmington, Canandaigua, and surrounding areas, Halco specializes in moisture control, structural repair, and complete basement remodeling using proven systems like TerraBlock insulation, SmartPipe drainage, and SaniDry dehumidifiers.

## Key Topics

- Total Basement Finishing (TBF)
- Crawl space encapsulation
- Basement waterproofing
- Moisture control and prevention
- SmartJack support posts
- TerraBlock insulation
- SaniDry dehumidifiers
- SmartPipe drainage systems
- Vapor barriers
- Mold prevention
- Structural support and repair
- Finger Lakes service area
- Geneva, Farmington, Canandaigua coverage
